svg.title: Couch Duel mockup
svg.desc: Two phones in portrait. Left: Couch Duel setup with two player cards (names, Starter Box forts, crew, Help), a rules panel and Fight. Right: the hand-off card over the dimmed battle, with the last shot, the next player name, their crest and a Ready button. Side cells show Player 2 identity, shape cues, Help marks and house rules.

text.font-family: Fredoka, 'Baloo 2', Nunito, 'Arial Rounded MT Bold', 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif

svg.text: Couch Duel: setup and the hand-off card

text.font-family: Nunito, Fredoka, 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif

svg.text: Two players, one device, per 07-ux 4.9. Player 1 is blue and round. Player 2 is orange and diamond, a Hob clan of their own.
